About Our Brand & Product
Planters Exchange is a boutique retail store based in St. Simons Island, Georgia. Our Boatkin Canvas Bags are a structured, elevated take on the everyday tote—designed to hold their shape, stand out in-store, and drive repeat customer interest.

What Makes This Product Sell
The Boatkin has quickly become a customer favorite thanks to its structured silhouette, premium canvas, and signature lock detail. It’s positioned as a high-perceived-value bag at an accessible price point, making it an easy “yes” for shoppers.

Why Partner With Us
We maintain strong inventory (200+ units in stock with additional orders arriving soon) and ship same-day via UPS, ensuring a reliable experience for your audience. Our team is hands-on and responsive—we’re here to help you succeed.

How Affiliates Earn
Earn commission by promoting the Boatkin Canvas Bag across your channels. This is a focused, single-product opportunity with strong visual appeal and proven sell-through both online and in-store.

How to Promote
Short-form video performs best. We recommend TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts featuring:

  • “The bag everyone’s talking about”

  • Side-by-side comparisons (structured vs. typical totes)

  • Everyday use styling (work, travel, daily carry)

We can provide content ideas and assets to help you get started quickly.

Additional Notes
We’re actively investing in this product and looking to build long-term relationships with a small group of high-performing affiliates.

Planters Exchange Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Effective Date: April 9, 2026

Welcome to Planters Exchange. By applying to or participating in our Affiliate Program (“Program”), you (“Affiliate,” “you”) agree to the following Terms and Conditions. These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and Planters Exchange (“we,” “us,” or “Merchant”).

If you do not agree to these terms in full, you are not authorized to participate in the Program.

1. Enrollment and Acceptance

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate application at our sole discretion, for any reason or no reason. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your application.

We may also revoke your participation in the Program at any time if you violate these Terms.

2. Affiliate Links, Codes, and Promotion

Affiliates will be provided with a unique referral link and may be assigned a coupon code.

  • Only the last-click referral link will be eligible for commission attribution.
  • Coupon codes may only be used if explicitly assigned to you.
  • You may not promote unauthorized or unassigned coupon codes.
  • You will not receive double commissions if both a link and coupon are used.

Affiliates may promote Planters Exchange products via:

  • Organic social media (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Email marketing (to opted-in audiences)
  • Content platforms (blogs, videos, etc.)

3. Prohibited Advertising and Brand Use

To protect brand integrity and ensure fair marketing practices, the following are strictly prohibited:

❌ Paid Advertising Restrictions

Affiliates may NOT run paid advertising campaigns using our brand, products, or affiliate links, including but not limited to:

  • Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Display, YouTube)
  • Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads
  • TikTok ads
  • Any other paid traffic source

❌ Boatkin Product Positioning & Brand References

When promoting Boatkin canvas bags, Affiliates may NOT:

  • Reference, mention, or compare the product to any other brand, designer, or trademarked product
  • Use language such as “dupe,” “inspired by,” “similar to,” or any comparison to other bags or brands
  • Use any third-party brand names or trademarks in captions, hashtags, descriptions, or content

Affiliates should present Boatkin bags as original products of Planters Exchange and avoid any implication of association with other brands.

❌ Brand Misrepresentation

Affiliates may NOT:

  • Misrepresent Planters Exchange products
  • Make false or misleading claims
  • Imply endorsement or partnership beyond this affiliate relationship

Violation of this section may result in:

  • Immediate termination from the Program
  • Forfeiture of unpaid commissions

4. Commissions and Payments

Affiliates earn commissions based on completed purchases made through their referral link or assigned code.

  • Commission is calculated based on net order value, excluding taxes, shipping, and fees
  • Commission rates are defined in the Affiliate Dashboard or Affiliate Guide
  • Payments are only issued for completed, non-refunded transactions
  • Orders that are refunded, canceled, or charged back are not eligible for commission

Affiliates must provide valid payment details to receive payouts.

5. Payment Schedule

Payment timing and methods will be outlined in the Affiliate Guide or Dashboard.

We reserve the right to review and validate all transactions prior to payment.

6. Marketing Materials

We may provide approved marketing assets (e.g., images, banners, product links).

  • Affiliates are encouraged to use these materials
  • Any custom content must comply with brand guidelines and these Terms

7. Affiliate Network (if applicable)

If enabled, Affiliates may invite others to join the Program.

  • Downline commissions (if offered) will be defined in the Affiliate Dashboard
  • Affiliates are responsible for ensuring their referrals comply with these Terms

8. Tracking and Cookies

We use cookies to track referrals.

  • If a user disables or clears cookies, tracking may not be possible
  • Cookie duration is defined during registration
  • All purchases within the cookie window may be attributed to the Affiliate

9. Program Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any Affiliate account at any time for:

  • Violation of these Terms
  • Fraudulent or suspicious activity
  • Brand misuse or unauthorized advertising

Affiliates may terminate participation at any time by contacting:

📧 robert@plantersexchange.com

10. Limitation of Liability

Planters Exchange is not liable for:

  • Tracking errors
  • System interruptions
  • Loss of commissions due to technical issues outside our control

11. Modifications

We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued participation in the Program constitutes acceptance of any changes.

12. Contact

For questions regarding the Affiliate Program:

📧 robert@plantersexchange.com

✅ Final Note

We’re excited to have you as part of the Planters Exchange Affiliate Program and appreciate your support in promoting our brand with integrity and professionalism.
